'''.prototype.'''<ref name="dt-17564">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17564 attn  Adam Amy], DeckTech (Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag, 16 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17564/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17564/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017221234/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17564/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''.prototype.''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
